ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low high-intensity to low-intensity ratio; predominantly dark gray/black surface (low-intensity) with isolated, high-contrast white pixels (scars/marks) occupying less than 10% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous base covering both lobes. High-contrast light pixel clusters mapped as linear sets (rake marks) in the mid-lobed regions and small stochastic white speckles distributed across the central and inferior sections of the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 95-degree V-shaped depression with a moderate vertical depth relative to the horizontal span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; notably jagged and deeply incised peaks at the distal end of the left lobe (viewer's perspective) transitioning to a lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both lobes, sweeping from the medial notch toward the distal tips, with a visible irregularity/truncation at the left tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete white circular clusters (1-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the lower third of the fluke surface, particularly near the peduncle junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive sets of parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented roughly vertically and diagonally across the mid-section of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged deformity or missing tissue segments at the distal tip of the left lobe; pervasive linear scarring (rake marks) across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'notched' topography of the left lobe's distal edge, distinguishing it from the relatively smoother (though still serrated) right lobe tip.
